headline: Real progress, and the gap between what is built and what is live is now the whole problem.
rules: Every rating is derived from a count we hold, never chosen. A score somebody picked is a mood with a number attached.
Unshipped scores ZERO. Not 'in progress', not 'on track'. A review that rewards work nobody can use is the most comfortable lie a solo founder can be told.
The trend matters more than the level. A 6 that was a 3 is a different story from a 6 that was a 9.

working: Every incident this month became a guard, and every guard has been deliberately broken to prove it works.

areas.verdict: Wide and shallow. We track a lot and verify less of it than the numbers suggest.
working: 177 of 207 sealed products priced today, 16,468 cards catalogued
Graded prices are WITHHELD because the source carries no time window — the right call, made after nearly publishing one
watch: Enrichment covers 12 cards. Volume and graded data exist on 0.07% of the catalogue.
6 knowledge-base facts rest only on secondary sources and have never been checked against our own data.

areas.verdict: The app works and looks better than it did. It is also still not deployed where anyone can use it.
working: Seven measured layout frames, a creator editor, a funnel, and 13 post shapes
Watermark and illustrator credit are locked and cannot be edited out
watch: Two shipped pages have no generator and drift further from the site every day.
The editor exists as a file. Nobody outside this conversation can reach it.
Newsletter 001: written, unshipped, and it has been for weeks.

areas.verdict: Real and growing, on evidence too thin to score confidently. Early-stage community is mostly invisible to measurement, which is not the same as absent.
working: Growing engagement on @longedeth with rising quality, founder-reported
Re-awakening lapsed collectors inside an existing community - the cheapest audience there is, because they already care
One measured post drew an unsolicited reply from a verified creator
watch: One post with hard numbers. Everything else is a founder's read of his own audience, which is real evidence and thin evidence at the same time.
None of this is captured anywhere but here. If Tyler stops reporting it, it becomes invisible again.
The audience is being built on a personal account. That is the right way to start and it means the community currently belongs to a person rather than to the product.

working: Best: 18800 views, 401 likes, and an unsolicited reply from a verified creator — at a bad hour from a small account
watch: The platform agents' judgments are still shape-based guesses until roughly twenty posts have outcomes.
We have a five-times performance difference between two post types and one observation of each. That is not enough to act on and we have been acting on it.

areas.verdict: The habits are in place. Nothing has come due yet, so none of them have been tested.
working: Corrections published publicly, dated and permanent
21 errors logged, each with the guard it produced
watch: 27 of 46 agent questions unanswered — a queue that only grows is a queue nobody reads
9 predictions still pending. The first grades land in October, and until then this score is a promise.
